title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
**Job Title:**

**Graphic Designer & Video Editor (AI Content Specialist)**

**Location:**

Kochi (On-site)

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a **creative technologist** who doesn’t just design visuals but *engineers attention*. This role blends **graphic design, video editing, and AI-powered content creation** to build high-impact digital assets for marketing, branding, and campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Graphic Design**

* Create high-quality creatives for:
* Social media (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube thumbnails)
* Ad campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
* Website banners, landing pages, brochures
* Ensure brand consistency across all visual assets
* Conceptualize campaign creatives with strong storytelling

**Video Editing**

* Edit high-conversion videos for:
* Ads & promotional campaigns
* YouTube & reels
* Corporate and product videos
* Add motion graphics, transitions, subtitles, and sound design
* Optimize videos for different platforms (short-form & long-form)
* **AI Video & Content Creation**
* Create AI-generated videos using tools like:
* Runway ML, Pika, Synthesia, Sora (or similar)
* Use AI tools for:
* Script-to-video generation
* Voiceovers
* Visual enhancements & automation
* Stay updated with emerging AI tools and implement them for faster content production

**Creative Strategy & Execution**

* Work closely with marketing and leadership teams to develop campaign ideas
* Translate business goals into compelling visual content
* Deliver content that improves engagement, reach, and conversions

**Required Skills**

* Strong proficiency in:
* Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator
* Premiere Pro / After Effects
* Hands-on experience in **video editing & motion graphics**
* Familiarity with **AI content creation tools**
* Understanding of **digital marketing creatives & trends**
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in **YouTube content optimization**
* Knowledge of **UI/UX basics**
* Basic scripting or storytelling ability
* Experience working with **educational / tech brands** is an advantage

**Experience**

* 1–4 years (Freshers with exceptional portfolio can apply)

**Key Traits We Value**

* Creativity with speed
* Ownership mindset
* Obsession with quality
* Hunger to learn new tools (especially AI)

**What Success Looks Like**

* High-performing creatives that drive leads & admissions
* Consistent brand visibility across platforms
* Faster content production using AI

**Why Join Us**

* Work at the intersection of **Creativity + AI + Marketing**
* Opportunity to build **next-gen content systems**
* Exposure to **global-level campaigns and branding**

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: UI/UX Designer Intern
description:
**About Vividhut**

Vividhut is a creative and digital marketing company focused on building impactful brands and digital experiences. We work across branding, social media marketing, website development, performance marketing, SEO, content, video, and creative design.

We are looking for a **UI/UX Designer Intern** who is creative, curious, and interested in designing intuitive and engaging digital experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in designing user-friendly and visually appealing website and mobile interfaces.
* Create wireframes, user flows, mockups, and prototypes.
* Conduct basic user research and competitor analysis.
* Translate ideas and requirements into clear UI/UX designs.
* Collaborate with the design, development, and marketing teams.
* Maintain consistency in layouts, typography, colors, and overall design systems.
* Make design improvements based on feedback and usability requirements.
* Support the team in creating website, landing page, and other digital interface designs.
* Stay updated with current UI/UX trends and design best practices.

**Requirements**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX principles and user-centered design.
* Familiarity with **Figma** or other UI/UX design tools.
* Understanding of wireframing, prototyping, typography, color theory, and layout.
* Good visual sense and attention to detail.
* Creative mindset with a willingness to learn and experiment.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* A portfolio or sample design work is preferred.

**What You'll Learn**

* Real-world UI/UX design workflows.
* Website and landing-page design.
* Wireframing and prototyping.
* Design systems and responsive design.
* User research and usability principles.
* Working with developers and creative teams.
* Handling real client and business requirements.

**Internship Benefits**

* **Internship Certificate:** An internship completion certificate will be provided upon successful completion of the internship.
* **Full-Time Job Opportunity:** Based on performance, skills, and business requirements, selected interns may have the opportunity to join Vividhut as a full-time employee after successfully completing the internship.
* Gain hands-on experience by working on real-world projects.
* Learn and collaborate with an experienced creative and digital team.

**Internship Details**

* **Duration:** 3 Months
* **Work Mode:** Hybrid
* **Location:** Kochi, Kerala
* **Schedule:** Monday to Friday

Pay: Up to ₹5,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Eloit**

Eloit Innovations is a fast\-growing Global SaaS / Software Product company building cutting\-edge solutions in education and faith\-based technologies. Eloit is on a mission to unlock potential through graceful innovation. Our flagship platforms include Edisapp School ERP, Credisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, and more, headquartered in London, with over a decade of innovation and operations in Kochi, India.

**Job Overview:**

We are looking for a talented and creative UI Developer with a strong eye for design and a passion for building intuitive, engaging, and user\-friendly digital experiences across web and mobile platforms.

The ideal candidate will combine strong UI/UX design skills with hands\-on frontend development expertise, particularly in Vue.js, to transform user and business requirements into high\-quality digital products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop intuitive, responsive, and visually engaging user interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Translate business and user requirements into user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Develop user\-facing applications and reusable UI components using Vue.js.
* Create and maintain design systems, style guides, UI patterns, and reusable design components to ensure consistency across products.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Convert functional requirements and user needs into simple, effective, and aesthetically appealing user experiences.
* Identify, analyse, and resolve UI/UX usability issues through research, testing, and iterative design.
* Create original visual assets, graphics, icons, and other UI elements when required.
* Ensure designs are responsive, accessible, scalable, and optimized for different screen sizes and devices.
* Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs and maintain visual consistency between design and production.
* Conduct design reviews and provide guidance on UI/UX best practices.
* Maintain clear documentation of design decisions, workflows, components, and interaction patterns.
* Stay updated with emerging UI/UX trends, frontend technologies, accessibility standards, and design methodologies.

Design and develop UI flows, menus, HUDs, and user\-facing applications that meet defined design goals; create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and supporting documentation; translate business and user requirements into style guides, design systems, design patterns, and attractive, consistent user interfaces; develop and maintain responsive user\-facing applications using Vue.js; create original graphic designs and visual assets where required; and identify, analyse, and troubleshoot UX and usability problems through iterative design and testing.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* Required Skills \& Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Design, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in UI development, UI/UX design, frontend development, or a related role.
* Strong proficiency in modern UI/UX design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with Vue.js and modern frontend development practices.
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, responsive design, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Good understanding of user\-centered design principles, information architecture, interaction design, and usability.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, design systems, and reusable UI components.
* Strong understanding of responsive web and mobile design principles.
* Ability to translate designs into functional, production\-ready interfaces.
* Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Good problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks.
* Knowledge of REST APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.
* Experience with mobile UI/UX design and mobile\-first design principles.
* Understanding of accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design.
* Experience working with design tokens and component libraries.
* Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience in designing products for education, ERP, SaaS, or enterprise applications.

**What We Value**

* A strong user\-first mindset.
* Creativity combined with practical problem\-solving.
* Ability to balance design quality, usability, and technical feasibility.
* Ownership of projects from concept through implementation.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and experiment with new technologies and design approaches.

**Why Eloit?**

At Eloit, you will not just be doing a job; you will be part of a mission. We build technology that impacts thousands of schools, students, and faith communities across the globe, and every person on our team plays a real role in that story.

We are a decade\-old, London\-headquartered Global SaaS / Software Product company with a passionate team in Kochi, India, building world\-class platforms trusted by 700\+ institutions across 4 continents. We move fast, we build things that matter, and we invest in the people who make it happen.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Day Shift
* Values\-driven and mission\-oriented work culture

**How to Apply?**

Interested candidates should submit a detailed resume and a cover letter explaining why they are a good fit for this role.

Email: jobs@eloit.com

Subject Line: Associate – Product Design

Know more about Eloit: www.eloit.com

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹360,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

* What is your current Salary
* What is your expected salary
* What is your Notice period
